name: Morph-ready geometric shape
description: Closed circle, regular polygon, star or rectangle path sampled at a fixed point count, starting at the top and running clockwise, so any two shapes with the same count morph cleanly with core GSAP (no MorphSVG).

inputs.name: points
inputs.description: Sample count; equal counts are morph-compatible

inputs.name: cx, cy, r
inputs.description: Centre and radius in the SVG user space

inputs.name: sides / spikes, inner / w, h
inputs.description: Polygon sides, star spikes and inner ratio, rectangle size

inputs.name: rotate
inputs.description: Angle of the first vertex in degrees

implementation.api: Studio.draw.shape(kind, {cx, cy, r, sides, spikes, inner, w, h, rotate, points}) -> path d

performance_notes: Pure path generation at build time; 48 points per shape is a few hundred bytes of path data.

validation.evidence: tests/studio-runtime/reference-techniques.html via tests/test-studio-runtime.py (structure compatibility, start at top, determinism, morph chain end state) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
